philosophy: Boris Cherny builds terminal-first agentic tools (Claude Code) that keep the human in the loop: the agent proposes, permission prompts gate risky actions, and state like todos, diffs and tool calls stays visible so users can trust a probabilistic system and recover when it errs. His background in type-safe APIs (Programming TypeScript, json-schema-to-typescript) shows in a preference for explicit contracts, progressive disclosure, and composable primitives (hooks, skills, plugins, subagents) over hidden magic.
